page.overview:
What is Harry Potter Books?

The Harry Potter books make up the popular Harry Potter franchise written by J. K. Rowling. The series spans seven novels. Due to their great success, the original books have been made into eight films by Warner Bros, which each also became very successful in their own right. The seventh and final book was split into two films due to its length. They have been adapted into video games as well, which have mixed results.

The books concern a young wizard called Harry Potter and his journey through Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. The stories tell of him overcoming dangerous obstacles to defeat the Dark Wizard Lord Voldemort, who killed his parents when Harry was 15 months old, along with the help of his best friends Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger. The first book, , was published in 1997 by Bloomsbury in London. The final book published ten years later in 2007, , sold more than 12 million copies in the U.S..

Beginning on 6 October 2015, the entire series was presented in a fully-illustrated format, with over 100 illustrations per title, by Jim Kay. The books were also all reunited in one ebook the same year.

It is said that J. K. Rowling sent her preliminary copy of to 12 publishers before it was accepted and published by Bloomsbury.
